73:         let buffer = &mut *self.buf;
74: 
75:         loop {

77:             // data to continue, thus maximizing the chances of a large write.
78:             if buffer.cap < buffer.buf.len() && !buffer.read_done {

80:                 read_buf.set_filled(buffer.cap);
81:                 match reader.as_mut().poll_read(cx, &mut read_buf) {

83:                         let filled_len = read_buf.filled().len();
84:                         buffer.read_done = buffer.cap == filled_len;
85:                         buffer.cap = filled_len;

88:                             feature = "io-std",

100:                             feature = "fs",
101:                             feature = "io-std",
102:                             feature = "net",
103:                             feature = "process",
104:                             feature = "rt",
105:                             feature = "signal",
106:                             feature = "sync",
107:                             feature = "time",
108:                         ))]
109:                         coop.made_progress();
110:                         return Poll::Ready(Err(err));
111:                     }
112:                     Poll::Pending => {
113:                         // Ignore pending reads when our buffer is not empty, because

120:                                 #[cfg(any(

122:                                     feature = "io-std",
123:                                     feature = "net",
124:                                     feature = "process",
125:                                     feature = "rt",
126:                                     feature = "signal",
127:                                     feature = "sync",
128:                                     feature = "time",
129:                                 ))]

132:                             }

134:                             return Poll::Pending;
135:                         }
136:                     }
137:                 }
138:             }
139: 
140:             // If our buffer has some data, let's write it out!
141:             while buffer.pos < buffer.cap {
142:                 let i = match Pin::new(&mut *writer)
143:                     .poll_write(cx, &buffer.buf[buffer.pos..buffer.cap])
144:                 {
145:                     Poll::Pending => {
146:                         // Top up the buffer towards full if we can read a bit more
147:                         // data - this should improve the chances of a large write
148:                         if !buffer.read_done && buffer.cap < buffer.buf.len() {
149:                             let mut read_buf = ReadBuf::new(&mut buffer.buf);
150:                             read_buf.set_filled(buffer.cap);
151:                             ready!(reader.as_mut().poll_read(cx, &mut read_buf))?;
152:                             let filled_len = read_buf.filled().len();
153:                             buffer.read_done = buffer.cap == filled_len;
154:                             buffer.cap = filled_len;
155:                         }
156:                         return Poll::Pending;
157:                     }
158:                     Poll::Ready(Ok(n)) => n,
159:                     Poll::Ready(Err(err)) => return Poll::Ready(Err(err)),
160:                 };
161:                 #[cfg(any(
162:                     feature = "fs",
163:                     feature = "io-std",
164:                     feature = "net",
165:                     feature = "process",
166:                     feature = "rt",
167:                     feature = "signal",

part.text:
The fix is implemented in `tokio/src/io/util/write_all_buf.rs:222-250`. The `WriteAllBuf` future now:

1. Checks `writer.is_write_vectored()` once before the write loop
2. If vectored, fills a 16-element `IoSlice` array via `Buf::chunks_vectored` each iteration and issues a single `poll_write_vectored` with all filled slices
3. Falls back to the original single-chunk `poll_write` path otherwise, preserving `WriteZero` error semantics and partial-write handling (re-scanning remaining chunks after each partial write)

Verified:
- `io_write_all_buf` tests: all 3 pass, including the new `write_all_buf_vectored` test (writer whose `poll_write` panics if called)
- `io_write_buf` (16), `io_write_all` (6), `io_buf_writer` (1), `io_split` (1): all pass
- `cargo check`/`cargo fmt --check` clean
